## The SRTR standard analysis files

*Will cover:* what the Scientific Registry of Transplant Recipients collects, how its standard analysis files are organized, and how follow-up is reported.

## Linking liver and kidney records

*Will cover:* why a simultaneous liver–kidney transplant appears in both the liver and the kidney files, and how the two records are linked and reconciled.

## Propensity score matching

*Will cover:* how a propensity score is estimated, how matched controls are chosen, and how balance between groups is checked.

## Time-to-event analysis in a matched cohort

*Will cover:* Kaplan–Meier curves, Cox models with standard errors that account for matched sets, and death-censored graft failure.
